items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 12:1
items.html: Adhesion is equivalence of form, which draws spiritual entities near and adheres them to one another, whereas disparity of form removes them from one another. (Part 1, Chapter 1, Inner Light, Item 30)
